items.title: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Execute Remote Code
items.description: Cisco has disclosed a severe vulnerability in its widely used IOS and IOS XE Software, potentially allowing attackers to crash devices or seize full control through remote code execution.
